items.title: Savita Oil Q2 FY27 EBITDA up 350% to Rs 296.4 cr; no data-centre disclosure
items.text: Savita Oil Technologies reported Q2 FY27 total income of Rs 1,714.1 crore, up 57.2%, and EBITDA of Rs 296.4 crore, up 350.3% from Rs 65.8 crore. EBITDA margin was 17.3% against 6.0%, and PBT rose 410.2% to Rs 283.1 crore. The page discusses ester-based immersion coolants for EV and BESS batteries but does not mention data centres or QuantiCool. The fluids leg's earnings therefore still rest on the core lubricants business, not on cooling-fluid revenue.
